main_text.head: SANCTUM JESU CHRISTI EVANGELIUM SECUNDUM MARCUM.
CAPUT I. VERS. I.
main_text.p: INitium, &c. Sensus est, narraturus lætissimum illud nuntium de redemtione generis humani, quod in mundum attulit Jesus Christus consubstantialis Dei Filius, à prædicatione Joannis exordium duco, quem ut Evangelii Præcursorem, ita quasi initium fuisse futurum, jam olim à Prophetis erat scripto consignatum.
2. Sicut scriptum est. Vide dicta à nobis Matth. 27. v. 9.Mitto Angelum, &c. Vide Matth. 11. v. 10.
3. Vox clamantis, & cætera quæ sequuntur usque ad versum duodecimum, exposita sunt Matth. 3.
4. Baptizans, & prædicans. Hoc καθ' ὑσεγν τεῖτιεν dictum est; neque enim Joannes vocationem à baptismo ordiebatur:

page.notes: The initial I is a large woodcut letter joined to "Nitium". Greek words in note 4 are reproduced as best as legible: "καθ' ὑσεγν τεῖτιεν" is uncertain [?]. The page furniture at top-left is a neighbouring page edge and was omitted. Note 2 and 3 marks are printed in the text as numerals with no reference mark in the body line visible to me.
